note: Unwitnessed leaves whose antecedent is provably uninhabited, so that no Examples/ application can ever be written for them. Read by scripts/check_witness_debt.py, which checks every name here against docs/status/declaration-index.json and fails if the theorem is no longer an unwitnessed leaf, if the emptiness proof no longer exists, or if either name is absent. These theorems stay inside the ungrounded and unapplied counts -- nothing in the build exercises them, and that is true -- and leave the work queue, because the work does not exist. An entry is a claim about the tree and is falsified the day somebody inhabits the type.
